instruction: Facade WWR And Overhang Retrofit From Init Model This task starts from Desktop input file: init.osm. Reference image is provided on the Desktop: init_plan.png. Modify the OpenStudio model as needed and save the required output as result.osm. 1. The output folder contains result.osm with size at least 500 bytes. 2. Result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10. 3. Result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:BuildingStory, 1 OS:Space named V14-Base, and 1 OS:ThermalZone. 4. The OS:Space references the OS:BuildingStory, references the OS:ThermalZone, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2. 5. The model has exactly 6 OS:Surface objects: 1 Floor surface, 1 RoofCeiling surface, and 4 Wall surfaces. 6. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 1 Ground and 5 Outdoors. 7. The model has exactly 4 OS:SubSurface objects, all counted window subsurfaces are FixedWindow, and the fixed-window count is exactly 4. 8. The model contains exactly 1 OS:ShadingSurface, 1 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem, 1 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList, and 1 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint. 9. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 22.00 m, Y span 14.00 m, and Z span 3.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m. 10. The sum of floor surface areas is 308.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 11. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 230.40 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 12. The total fixed-window area is 62.72 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 13. The total shading surface area is 24.144 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
